name: uibc-verifier
description: UIBC Core verification agent: verifies sealed evidence packages (S1-S6), issues gate decisions (ALLOW/DENY/HOLD), and checks certificates. Read-only per docs/api-scope.md v1.0.

skills.name: Verify UIBC package
skills.description: Run S1-S6 verification on a .uibc package directory. Strict mode requires the owner key (key_hex). Returns PASS/FAIL with per-check detail.

skills.name: Gate decision
skills.description: Return a governed decision ALLOW/DENY/HOLD (exit 0/2/3 semantics) for a package, honoring signed revocations. Disputes annotate, never silently block.

skills.name: Verify certificate
skills.description: Check a UIBC certificate (C1-C7) and optionally its binding to a package.
